basic_field_caveat: Demographics were measured after choices. Using age/education as stable antecedent attributes requires explicitly stated retrospective-measurement assumption, not a claim of pre-choice collection.
knowledge_items: Pre-treatment, but exclude from initial background to keep input minimal and avoid explicitly teaching answers to the information manipulation; can be preregistered separately.
unresolved_source_conflicts: English survey overview places attitudes in Part A, whereas original German PDF interleaves them after choice blocks.
English age overview uses 30–49; original PDF and SAV both use 30–39.
Original food-waste page includes five statements plus attention check, while SAV names and labels shift to four substantive items. Do not map by matching variable name alone.

license_vs_consent.concern: Original participant notice says data used exclusively by doctoral researcher and supervisor for analysis. Public release license alone does not establish that this notice permits external AI processing.
license_vs_consent.decision: No participant-level cloud processing until the discrepancy is resolved. Public product-card and wholly synthetic technical checks remain separate.
